official_gazette.name: Journal officiel de la République française (JORF) / DILA Open Data
official_gazette.note: legifrance.gouv.fr blocks direct automated fetches (403); official daily XML archives of JORF and LEGI codes are open at https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/.

open_data_portal.name: data.gouv.fr
open_data_portal.note: Official French national open data catalog (REST API v1 & v2).

geoportal.name: cartes.gouv.fr (replacing Géoportail) / IGN Géoplateforme
geoportal.note: geoportail.gouv.fr redirects to cartes.gouv.fr; OGC WFS/WMTS/Atom backend runs at https://data.geopf.fr/.

latest_orthophoto.name: IGN BD ORTHO® (HR.ORTHOIMAGERY.ORTHOPHOTOS)
latest_orthophoto.note: Official flight table (updated 2026-11-02) shows 20 cm aerial imagery up to 2026 (depts 13, 14, 35, 70, 83, 90); most depts 2023-2026.

cadastre.name: cadastre.gouv.fr & cadastre.data.gouv.fr (DGFiP / DINUM)
cadastre.note: cadastre.gouv.fr serves interactive sheet viewing (598,788 vector sheets); cadastre.data.gouv.fr hosts open bulk GeoParquet/GeoJSON/SHP/EDIGÉO.
